name: Strange Sources
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
To tell you the truth, although there are no volcanoes here in Winterspring, I believe that there are far more threatening reasons for these hot springs...

Well, I think you'll want to see it for yourself. You'll need to travel the length of Winterspring, and head to the very south. When the air becomes thick and muggy, and the sky turns dark, you'll have found what I believe to be the source of the hot springs.

Have a look. I'm sure you'll have many questions when you return.
narrative.objectives: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, the demons there in Darkwhisper Gorge; I believe it is their presence that is affecting the land in this way. I am going to continue observing the hot springs here and see if I learn anything more.

I'd wait until you are a bit stronger if you have plans of heading farther into Darkwhisper Gorge.
narrative.requestItemsText: The water in the springs seems to have some very odd properties... I am still unsure of what it means...

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 55 to 56, 14,250 XP in all.

quests.name: Finding the Source
quests.objectiveText: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge. Whenever you find a hot spot, right click the thermometer to check the temperature.

quests.name: The New Springs
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Winterspring and speak with Donova Snowden.

quests.name: Strange Sources
quests.objectiveText: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.
